description.en: The ID of the FeatureStore instance. Call the ListInstances operation to get the instance ID.
The name of the data source.

description.zh:
排序方式，取值如下：

- Asc - 升序排列。

- Desc - 降序排列。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- Asc: ascending order.

- Desc: descending order.

description.zh: 页码，起始值为1，默认值为1。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.
The number of data sources per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
数据源类型，取值如下：

- Hologres
- Redis
- MaxCompute
description.en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- Hologres

- Redis

- MaxCompute
The ID of the workspace. Call the [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) operation to get the workspace ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun paifeaturestore list-datasources --instance-id featureStore-cn-XXXXXXX --workspace-id 234 --type MaxCompute --name datasource1 --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --order Asc --sort-by GmtModifiedTime --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun paifeaturestore GET /api/v1/instances/featureStore-cn-XXXXXXX/datasources --region cn-hangzhou --Order Asc --Type MaxCompute --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy GmtModifiedTime --WorkspaceId 234 --Name datasource1 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
